queer_characters.name: Todd Chavez
queer_characters.notes: Todd's asexual awakening occurs in season three; in the finale he explicitly grapples with his identity ('I don't think I'm straight... I think I might be nothing') and by season six identifies with the ace community, creating an asexual dating app and dating Maude. Treated with genuine depth rather than ridicule.

queer_characters.name: Maude
queer_characters.notes: Maude is a rabbit Todd meets through his asexual dating app 'All About That Ace,' which strongly implies she is also asexual, though the source text does not state her identity in her own words.
